name: dobe_rub5b
desc: pink goo doberman seen from behind hugging someone tightly, slowly and heavily grinding its broad chest against them with a small up and down stroke of about five pixels: its shoulders, arms and head press in and drag upward a little, then drag back down, like pressing and smearing, heavy and sluggish, not bouncy, no squash and stretch, its body shape stays firm. Its waist, lower body and the goo stalk stay stuck to the pillar and do not move. No sideways movement, eyes hidden, sticky goo smearing, looping
